title: Pretty Points
story: The guild hall plots points on a map. Make them print nicely, compare, and add.
goal: Write class Point(x, y) with __repr__ (like Point(1, 2)), __eq__ and __add__ (adds coordinates, returns a new Point).
hints: Special methods have double underscores on both sides. Python calls them for you.
__repr__ returns a string. __eq__(self, other) compares fields. __add__ returns a new Point.
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Pretty Points”?
